yearLabel: Year of assessment 2026/27 (1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027)

provenance.source: Inland Revenue Ordinance (Cap. 112); IRD salaries tax rates and allowances for 2026/27; Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Tax Concessions, Concessionary Deductions and Allowances) Bill 2026; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Hong Kong SAR
provenance.notes: Rates, the two-tiered standard rate and the 2026/27 allowances (basic allowance raised to HKD 145,000) were read from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries and the Hong Kong government press release on the 2026-27 Budget on 31 August 2026. Not reconciled line by line against the Inland Revenue Ordinance.

omissions: Married person's allowance and joint assessment are out of scope, as is personal assessment.
Dependent brother/sister, disabled dependant and single parent allowances are not modelled.
The territorial source rules are not modelled: the app assumes all income is Hong Kong sourced and chargeable.

progressiveScale.note: Applied to NET CHARGEABLE INCOME, that is income after deductions AND after personal allowances.

standardScale.legalRef: Schedule 1, Inland Revenue Ordinance (two-tiered standard rates)
standardScale.note: Applied to NET INCOME, that is income after deductions but BEFORE personal allowances. Two-tiered since 2024/25.

mpf.note: Employees contribute 5% of relevant income. No employee contribution is due in a month where relevant income is below the minimum level, and contributions are capped at 5% of the maximum level. The deduction is capped separately at HKD 18,000 a year.

regions.name: Hong Kong SAR
regions.note: Salaries tax is territory-wide. There is no district or provincial component.

inputSchema.label: Income from employment (per month)
inputSchema.help: Salary, wages, bonuses, commissions and allowances, month by month. Leave a month blank if you had no employment income then.

inputSchema.label: Provisional salaries tax paid (per month)
inputSchema.help: Hong Kong does not withhold at source. Enter any provisional tax you have already paid for the year so the app can show what is left to settle.

inputSchema.label: MPF mandatory contributions actually paid (override)
inputSchema.help: Leave blank to have the app compute 5% of relevant income within the statutory levels. The deduction is capped at HKD 18,000 whatever you paid.

inputSchema.label: Self-education expenses
inputSchema.help: Fees for a prescribed course of education connected to your employment. Capped at HKD 100,000. A hobby course does not qualify.

inputSchema.label: Home loan interest
inputSchema.help: Interest on a loan to buy a dwelling you occupy. Capped at HKD 100,000 a year and limited to a fixed number of years of assessment. You cannot claim this and domestic rent for the same year.

inputSchema.label: Domestic rent
inputSchema.help: Rent paid on your principal residence under a stamped tenancy. Capped at HKD 100,000. Not available if you or your spouse own a dwelling, and not combinable with home loan interest.

inputSchema.label: Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme premiums
inputSchema.help: Premiums on a certified VHIS policy for yourself or a specified relative. Capped at HKD 8,000 per insured person; this app applies a single cap.

inputSchema.label: Qualifying annuity premiums and tax-deductible MPF voluntary contributions
inputSchema.help: Combined cap of HKD 60,000 a year, separate from the HKD 18,000 mandatory MPF cap.

inputSchema.label: Approved charitable donations
inputSchema.help: Donations of HKD 100 or more to an approved charity. Limited to 35% of your income after the other deductions.

inputSchema.label: Number of dependent children
inputSchema.help: Unmarried children under 18, or under 25 in full-time education, or unable to work through disability. HKD 140,000 each.

inputSchema.label: Of those, children born during the year
inputSchema.help: A child born during the year of assessment attracts an additional HKD 140,000 allowance for that year only.

inputSchema.label: Dependent parents or grandparents aged 60 or above
inputSchema.help: You must contribute at least HKD 12,000 a year to each one's maintenance. HKD 55,000 each.

inputSchema.label: Of those, living with you throughout the year
inputSchema.help: An additional HKD 55,000 each where the parent resides with you continuously and without paying full cost.
